title: Write the second phase
starter:
%x = buffer 16 dtype=f32 slot=0
%o = buffer 16 dtype=f32 slot=1
%sh = alloc 4 dtype=f32
%b = range 4 axis=global
%m = mul %b 4
%t = range 4 axis=local
%i = add %m %t
%xv = shrink %x %i []
%xe = load %xv
%sv = shrink %sh %t []
%s1 = store %sv %xe
%e1 = end %s1 %t
%sh1 = after %sh %e1
%eb = end %e1 %b

hints: Phase 2 is a new loop %u = range 4 axis=local. The slot to read is (u + 1) mod 4: an add, then a mod.
Load through %sh1, the shared memory after phase 1: %rv = shrink %sh1 %r [], then %re = load %rv. Store it at %o, offset %m plus %u.
Close the phase with %e2 = end %s2 %u, and change the block's last line to %eb = end %e1 %e2 %b so the block contains both phases. Finish with %o1 = after %o %eb.

answer.code:
%x = buffer 16 dtype=f32 slot=0
%o = buffer 16 dtype=f32 slot=1
%sh = alloc 4 dtype=f32
%b = range 4 axis=global
%m = mul %b 4
%t = range 4 axis=local
%i = add %m %t
%xv = shrink %x %i []
%xe = load %xv
%sv = shrink %sh %t []
%s1 = store %sv %xe
%e1 = end %s1 %t
%sh1 = after %sh %e1
%u = range 4 axis=local
%a = add %u 1
%r = mod %a 4
%rv = shrink %sh1 %r []
%re = load %rv
%j = add %m %u
%ov = shrink %o %j []
%s2 = store %ov %re
%e2 = end %s2 %u
%eb = end %e1 %e2 %b
%o1 = after %o %eb
answer.explain: Phase 2 is a second local loop. Thread u loads sh[(u + 1) mod 4], a slot its neighbor stored in phase 1, and stores it at o[4b + u]. Reading a neighbor's slot is safe because the two loops are two phases, with a barrier between them. The block's end lists both phases.

require: phase 2 is a second local loop: %u = range 4 axis=local
in phase 2, load from shared memory (%sh1), not from %x again
